recognize_zh: 高倍抹片中幾乎全為大型芽細胞（blast）：核圓至不規則、染色質細緻、N:C 比高，細胞質呈一圈嗜鹼性且顆粒極少，視野中看不到逐步成熟的骨髓系細胞，並有一個有絲分裂像，符合 AML without maturation。
features: Predominance of large blasts with high N:C ratio
Round to oval, occasionally folded nuclei with finely dispersed chromatin
Scant to moderate basophilic cytoplasm with few or no granules; no Auer rods seen
Absence of maturing granulocytic precursors in this field
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear at high power shows a near-monotonous population of large blasts with high N:C ratio, round to slightly irregular nuclei, finely dispersed chromatin, and a rim of basophilic, largely agranular cytoplasm. A mitotic figure is present. Maturing granulocytic elements (promyelocytes through neutrophils) are not seen in this field, and Auer rods are not identified. Findings are consistent with acute myeloid leukemia; the lack of maturation supports AML without maturation, which requires ≥3% MPO/SBB-positive blasts and <10% maturing granulocytic cells.

ddx.vs: Morphology is identical; AML-M0 blasts are <3% MPO/SBB positive and myeloid lineage is shown only by flow cytometry.
Lymphoblasts are usually smaller with scant cytoplasm and are MPO-negative with CD19/CD22 or cytoplasmic CD3 expression on flow.
AML with maturation shows ≥10% maturing granulocytic cells (promyelocytes to neutrophils), which are lacking here.
Monoblasts have more abundant gray-blue cytoplasm, occasional vacuoles, and are nonspecific esterase positive.
